voice: Loud, jovial, Western UP Hindi, Haryanvi edges; threats are delivered softly

metahuman.note: MetaHuman Creator 5.8 body: use the Parametric Body tool, set the constraint targets listed below (cm; the tool shows the real constraint list for the model, use the ones it offers), then blend presets only to taste. Face: blend 2-3 South Asian presets then Sculpt/Move to the notes. Hair/beard from the Groom library.
metahuman.face_notes: Wide square face, heavy jaw, small eyes, thick neck, a broken nose that healed flat

skin.description: Fair wheatish, flushed; heavy jaw; shaving rash
skin.note: U/V are starting values for the Creator skin-tone picker; judge by eye under neutral light and adjust

fallback_mannequin.note: Applied automatically by UBodyStateComponent when the mesh has no morph targets

outfits.summer: Branded half-sleeve shirt, unbuttoned one too many; formal trousers; leather slip-ons
outfits.monsoon: Dark shirt; cargo pants; rubber-soled shoes
outfits.winter: Quilted puffer jacket with a fictional logo; wool cap
outfits.by_act: A1=flashy, new money; A6=the same style, older and a bit too tight; he lives above a shop in a fourth-floor flat

accessories: Heavy gold chain; gold rings on three fingers; a smartphone; a fictional-brand watch; an SUV key fob (fictional)
tells: Never looks at the person he is lying to; touches the chain when he decides
gait_notes: Wide stance; chest first; sits with his legs apart; breathes through his mouth after one flight of stairs but wins a clinch because of mass
sensitivity: A criminal, written as a person: friendly, afraid, defensive. No stereotype of a region or caste.
